sentimento.text1: 📈 THE WINNER CONTRACT SPREAD WIDENED FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE Sep 11, and it widened little: Flávio Bolsonaro at 49.65% (vol USD 10.54M) and Lula at 47.50% (vol USD 10.92M), against 49.95% and 48.50% in the confirmed reading of Sep 12. The distance went from 1.45pp to 2.15pp. ⚖️ The proportion is what matters here: yesterday the same spread CLOSED 10.00pp in a single day, and today it gives back 0.70pp, about seven percent of what it moved the day before. Both sides eased, which means the widening came from Lula pulling back more, not from his rival advancing. Presidential book at USD 149.26M.
sentimento.text2: 🗳️ NO NEW NATIONAL POLL WAS RELEASED ON Sep 13, and that is calendar, not absence of measurement. The Superior Electoral Court registry, ingested on this date, carries TWELVE national polls scheduled for release between Sep 14 and Sep 18, and they cluster: NEXUS and Quaest on Sep 14, MDA and Indexa on Sep 15, Datatrends and American Analytics on Sep 16, FIVE on the same Sep 17 (AtlasIntel, Datafolha, PoderData, Gerp and 100 Cidades) and the Veritá poll of 40,500 interviews on Sep 18. ⚠️ Five houses publishing on the same day is the hardest test this window has produced, because on Aug 21 two national polls released on the same day went as far as inverting the runoff between them.
sentimento.text3: 📊 WHAT CAME OUT ON THE NIGHT OF Sep 12 WAS STATE-LEVEL, and for that reason it does not enter the national table on this page: Datafolha published five surveys, in São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Pernambuco and the Federal District. In the first round they put Flávio Bolsonaro ahead in SP (35% to 33%), in RJ (39% to 35%) and in the DF (40% to 32%), and Lula ahead in MG (37% to 35%) and in PE (55% to 24%). In the runoff pairs, SP comes out 47% to 42% and RJ 49% to 41% for the former, and PE comes out 61% to 30% for the latter. 📌 These are five federal units, not the country, and the page records this as coverage and not as national vote intention.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 49.65% in the winner contract, down 0.30pp for the second day and 5.45pp below his series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10, and 77.00% in the first-round runner-up contract, which publishes a price again. In the Datafolha poll of Sep 11 he has 35% in the first round and 44% in the runoff pair against Lula, a 2-point difference that fits inside the 2.0 margin. In the same house, on Sep 3, he had 44% in the pair, and on Aug 21 he had 43%. Ronaldo Caiado is at 0.15% in the winner contract, rose 0.50pp in the first-round third-place contract, to 8.50%, and has 4% in the Datafolha first round.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 47.50% in the winner contract, down 1.00pp, which gives back one sixth of the 6.00pp rise of the day before, and 20.00pp below his series high, of 67.50% on Aug 16. In the first-round runner-up contract, which publishes a price again, he is at 22.00%. In the Datafolha poll of Sep 11 he has 39% in the first round and 46% in the runoff pair, and it is the national poll that breaks a run of eight since Sep 6 in which he had not appeared ahead in the pair. He wins the five pairs tested by the house, and in three of them the distance falls outside the margin. Fernando Haddad remains at 0.05% in the winner contract, with USD 7.53M accumulated.
sentimento.terceiraVia: Augusto Cury is the favourite in the first-round third-place contract, with 55.60% and a 0.20pp fall, and has 6% in the first round of the Datafolha poll of Sep 11. Renan Santos fell 2.50pp in that same contract, to 34.50%, the largest move of any contract on the panel in this round, and has 3% in the poll, but his winner contract still carries USD 13.36M accumulated, the second largest individual volume in the book, behind only that of Tarcísio de Freitas, with USD 14.07M. Since both eased and one eased more, the gap between them in that contract WIDENED from 18.80pp to 21.10pp. Romeu Zema records 2% in the first round and loses the runoff pair to Lula by 48% to 39%, outside the margin.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of Sep 13, 13:17 BRT (16:17 UTC). ⭐ In this round FOUR of the five monitored contracts received a new price: winner, first-round runner-up, first-round third place and impeachment at the Supreme Court. The Senate majority contract does not publish a new price on Sep 13. AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, and the confirmation is done contract by contract.

inss.text1: 🔴 THE ACT OF Sep 12 IS ABOUT JURISDICTION, AND IT REACHES THE INSS: on Saturday night, Edson Fachin took over as rapporteur of the investigation into suspicions involving Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro and ordered André Mendonça to send him the cases on Banco Master and on the INSS fraud (Folha de S.Paulo and Gazeta do Povo, outlets from groups independent of each other, both on Sep 12). ⚠️ The body of the reports supports that he PULLED THE CASES TO HIMSELF, and not that he removed the other justice from the role, which is a different and stronger claim. The page writes the first one.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 What links the INSS to the Master case here is procedural, not factual: the two sets now have the same rapporteur. The page does not merge the objects of investigation, which remain distinct, and records only that jurisdiction changed hands on Sep 12.
inss.impactoLula: The structured reading of government approval remains the Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 7, with fieldwork from Sep 3 to Sep 6: 43% approve and 50% disapprove. The panel keeps one house per block on purpose, so that the internal series does not mix. 📊 And the Datafolha poll of Sep 11, from another house, measures 47% approval against 50% disapproval: the two converge exactly on disapproval and differ by 4 points on approval.
inss.impactoGestao: Within Quaest itself the picture is no longer one of stillness. On Aug 5 it was 48% approval against 47% disapproval, on Aug 14 46% against 48%, on Sep 2 45% against 48% and on Sep 7 43% against 50%. That is 5 points of decline in approval and 3 points of rise in disapproval over about a month, measured by the same house and with the same design. ⚠️ The management scale in this block, with 35% rating it excellent or good, is still the one from the Sep 2 round, because the Sep 7 release did not carry that breakdown, and the page declares the seam instead of giving the set a single date.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the topic is narrow and procedural: there is no act of the INSS itself, there is a change of rapporteur that reaches the INSS cases as of Sep 12, and the structured government approval reading remains the Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 7. The movement of the day is in the market, where the winner contract spread gave back 0.70pp of the 10.00pp it had closed the day before.

bancoMaster.text1: 🔴 THE ACT OF Sep 12 HAS TWO MOMENTS, AND THE SECOND IS THE ONE THAT CHANGES JURISDICTION. In the morning, at 11:43, Edson Fachin denied Alexandre de Moraes's request for a unified trial with André Mendonça, kept the Sep 15 session and set a second one for Sep 23. At night, around 21:00, he took over as rapporteur of the investigation into Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro and ordered Mendonça to send him the cases on Master and on the INSS fraud (Folha de S.Paulo at 20:49 and Gazeta do Povo, groups independent of each other). ⚠️ The body of the Gazeta do Povo text supports the pulling of the cases, not the removal of the justice from the role, and the page keeps the wording the body supports.
bancoMaster.text2: 📅 THE CHRONOLOGY THAT THE RECORD SUPPORTS, and it has four distinct days: on the night of Sep 10, at 23:44, André Mendonça granted a request from Edson Fachin and lifted the secrecy on 14 proceedings in the Master case; on Sep 11 the content became public, and it was through it that it became known that senator Flávio Bolsonaro has been under Federal Police investigation SINCE JULY of 2026, authorised by Mendonça himself; on Sep 12 the President of the Court separated the trials in the morning and pulled the cases to himself at night; and on Sep 13 the Federal Police answered the 24-hour deadline he had set about Vorcaro's phone, saying it has the technical means to send a copy to the justices.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The price on this page is from the confirmed reading of 13:17 BRT on Sep 13. In that reading, the winner contract of the man under investigation eased 0.30pp, after having fallen 4.00pp the day before, and the spread to the runner-up WIDENED 0.70pp. AFOS records the order of the facts and does not attribute cause to the price, because the book is continuously arbitraged and no single reading separates one motive from another.
bancoMaster.conclusao: What changes from Sep 12 to Sep 13 is not the content of the case, it is who conducts it and what the Federal Police answers. On Sep 12 the Court defined who judges what and when, and by the end of the day it changed the rapporteur of both sets of cases; on Sep 13 the Federal Police stated it has the means to hand over the copy of the material. The session remains set for Sep 15 and will be broadcast by TV Justiça, which makes it the first public act of the proceeding, less than a month from the first round.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act on Sep 13. He remains a target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos, together with Alexandre de Moraes.
stf.moraes: No new individual act on Sep 13. On Sep 12 Fachin denied his request for a unified trial with André Mendonça, which he had made by official letter alleging a risk of contradictory rulings. The session that examines the request to investigate him remains set for Sep 15 and will be broadcast by TV Justiça.
stf.gilmar: No new individual act on Sep 13. On Sep 12 he asked Fachin for access to the full copy of the media extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone, reinforcing a request Cristiano Zanin had already made, on the eve of the Sep 15 session.
stf.dino: No new individual act on Sep 13. On Sep 10 he authorised the Federal Police operation on the financing of the film Dark Horse and ordered precautionary measures against Mario Frias, and on Sep 9 he had reversed the removal of the Federal Police leadership.
stf.mendonca: No new individual act on Sep 13. On Sep 12 he became the addressee of Fachin's order to send over the Master and INSS cases, and on the same day he ordered the auction of a property belonging to Daniel Vorcaro. On Sep 10 he lifted the secrecy on 14 proceedings at Fachin's request and on Sep 11 released additional documents, keeping part under seal, which Moraes contested.
stf.nexo: The link to the election is one of calendar and institution, not of outcome. In four days the secrecy on 14 proceedings fell, the content made public that one of the candidates has been under investigation since July, the President of the Court split the trials into two sessions and then pulled the Master and INSS cases to himself, and the Federal Police declared it has the means to hand over the phone material. The first session, on Sep 15, falls less than a month from the first round and will be broadcast live.
stf.analise: 🏛️ THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 GAVE BACK THE WHOLE EXCURSION: it stands at 4.60% (vol USD 90 thousand), confirmed reading of Sep 13, 13:17 BRT, against 6.70% in the confirmed reading of Sep 12, a fall of 2.10pp. 📉 In the closing values recorded in the backup the contract closed Sep 10 at 4.60%, rose to 7.30% on Sep 11 and 6.70% on Sep 12, and today's confirmed reading gives back exactly the 4.60% of Sep 10, meaning the book returned to the point it left from. ⚠️ It is NOT an extreme: it remains 21.50pp below the series high, of 26.10% recorded on Sep 11 at 05:00 BRT, and 2.50pp above the floor, of 2.10% on Jun 8, and it is the 177th lowest of 504 points recorded since Apr 14. ⚠️ The accumulated volume, of USD 90 thousand, is small enough for isolated orders to move the price, and that caveat holds in both directions: it held when it jumped on Sep 11 and it holds now that it has given back. 📌 The move happens on the two days when the Court's proceedings advanced most, with the cases being pulled on Sep 12 and the Federal Police response on Sep 13. The order of the facts is measured, the link between them is not.
stf.fachin: 🔴 NEW ACT ON Sep 12, AT NIGHT: he took over as rapporteur of the investigation into suspicions involving Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro and ordered André Mendonça to send him the cases on Banco Master and on the INSS fraud (Folha de S.Paulo and Gazeta do Povo, independent groups, both on Sep 12). Earlier the same morning he had denied the unified trial, kept the Sep 15 session and set another for Sep 23, and given the Federal Police 24 hours to clarify the custody of Vorcaro's phone.
